items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: That's the first time I played with him. I met Johah before that, I met him when I was with Trent.

ctx.x: He's from around there. He's from Louisville. Just before we went into the hotel, we played a colored dance at one of those halls and Jonah was there and he came up and said I'm Jonah Jones--of course that didn't mean very much to him, but we were a bunch of nice guys, I would say that about all of them, they took up with everybody.
They weren't snobs that would turn anybody away.
